items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, that band was you and then Herbie Hall... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah -yeah.

ctx.x: Yes, I did that in Canada - we worked eight weeks at a time; once we did that four times in one year.
Now, that band was you and then Herbie Hall, on clarinet and, uh Benny Morton - was it - on trombone?
